_comment: Hand-authored Olist-style gold (8–12 Qs). Point connection at a Brazilian e-commerce schema (orders, order_items, customers, products, sellers, payments, reviews). Placeholder — not tied to a checked-in SQLite file; load via your Olist dump path (env OLIST_DB_PATH).
db_note: Expected tables: orders, order_items, customers, products, sellers, order_payments, order_reviews, geolocation

items.question: How many orders are in the dataset?
How many orders were delivered?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

items.question: What is the average payment value?
Which product category has the most items sold?
items.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the average review score?
How many payments used credit card?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

items.question: How many sellers are in each state?
items.gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY n DESC

items.question: What is the total freight value across all order items?
How many delivered orders arrived after the estimated delivery date?
items.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date
